candidate_sources.reason: Complete menu screen capture passes 8237 native pixel, state, callback, allocation, fault and unwind scenarios. VC6 emits 888 bytes against the complete 896-byte retail body with 284 matching positions. Rendering, surfaces, format lookup, allocation and texture creation are scripted; real DirectDraw capture and modal menus remain untested, and PCTextureMap CreateSurface is still a missing provider.

Complete MediaControl Open passes 11125 native scripted COM, OS and helper scenarios including output aliasing, callback mutations, failures and faults. VC6 emits 656 bytes against the complete 646-byte retail body with 53 matching positions. Actual SDK and canonical GUID providers are checked; live DirectShow decoding, DirectDraw drivers and downstream Release cleanup remain untested.

Complete race-to-menu transition passes 9437 native state, display/input, callback, allocation, fault and unwind scenarios. VC6 emits 533 bytes against the complete 531-byte retail body with 454 matching positions; generated TransDlg destructor helpers are strict. GUI, display, IME, result-recording, audio and allocation boundaries are scripted; live menu rendering and device transitions remain untested.

Complete replay worker passes 24595 native event, payload, whole-state, lock, failure, mutation and termination scenarios. Both complete extents are 2148 bytes, with 2100 matching positions. Twenty existing ring/file helpers, synchronization APIs and thread exit are scripted; actual scheduling, file I/O and integrated recording/playback remain untested.

Complete KrustyUI startup passes 13540 native whole-state, allocation, exception, fault, profile and callback scenarios; generated Intro1Dlg destructor helpers match strictly. VC6 emits 1102 bytes against 1104 retail bytes with 872 matching positions. GUI, resource, profile and device dependencies are scripted; rendered menus and live navigation remain untested.

Complete VCRInterface replay tick passes 147749 native whole-state, callback, lock, exception, fault and floating-point scenarios with the real VC6 conversion helper. VC6 emits 2448 bytes against 2412 retail bytes, retaining 276 matching positions. Seven game helpers and synchronization boundaries are scripted; actual worker scheduling and replay-file playback remain untested.

Complete FollowCamera control handler passes 195339 native input, whole-state, callback, exception, fault and floating-point scenarios. VC6 emits 4046 bytes against the complete 4058-byte retail body, retaining 927 matching positions. Input callbacks are scripted; real DirectInput and rendered camera behavior remain untested.

Complete FollowCamera Tick passes 674335 native full-state, callback, allocation, fault and floating-point comparisons with actual initialized strict FastSqrt. VC6 retains 3659 of 3672 matching positions; axis initializers are strict. Terrain, rotation, other camera methods and input callbacks are scripted, so rendered-camera behavior remains untested.

Complete streamed-audio loader passes 37387 native queue, ownership, lock, callback, exception and fault comparisons. VC6 emits 478 bytes versus 483 retail bytes; the five game helpers and synchronization boundaries are scripted, so real scheduling and audio playback remain untested.

Complete tooltip placement and pointer ownership helpers pass 19606 native state, coordinate, callback, exception and fault comparisons. VC6 emits the full 106/52-byte extents with 89/46 matching positions; ShowText and real input devices remain outside this scripted boundary test.

Complete defaults reset and data-file lookup pass 21332 native scripted comparisons and 192 actual VC6 CRT file searches. Full retail extents are 427/355 bytes; VC6 emits 427/357 bytes. CD discovery and prompts remain scripted.

Complete 158-byte primary-buffer PCM format setup passes 172032 native state, initialized-payload, callback, exception and fault cases. VC6 retains 108 matching positions; trailing uninitialized format bytes and real sound-device behavior are not established.

Complete 492-byte matrix update passes 76288 native scripted state/argument/exception cases and 9216 cases with initialized source math providers. VC6 retains 487 matching positions; real rendering remains untested.

Complete non-local texture-memory probe passes 12912 native full-state, call, alias, fault and ownership comparisons. Full retail CFG is 486 bytes including the final ret8; VC6 emits 490 bytes. Dependencies are scripted and invalid-path behavior is retained.

Complete partial-upload startup probe passes 26600 native state, ownership, ordered-call, C++ exception and access-violation scenarios. Full retail CFG is 1129 bytes; standalone VC6 candidate is 1145 bytes. Image, texture and display dependencies are scripted.

Complete display-mode surface setup passes 200448 native arithmetic, budget-boundary, whole-state and callback comparisons. VC6 emits 124 bytes versus 116 retail; invalid mode storage is outside this finite validation.

Complete channel comparison passes 144944 native pixel, pitch, lock-failure and callback comparisons, including 256/512/1024-square images. The full retail CFG is 629 bytes, including its cold tail; VC6 emits 620 bytes.

Complete UIDialog Tick passes 73728 native whole-state and mutating-callback comparisons. The retail CFG is 543 bytes including cold joystick branches; VC6 emits 555 bytes. Dependencies are scripted; end-to-end menus remain untested.

Complete ProfileDisplays passes 8486 native state, ordered-call, resource and unwind comparisons. The unchanged VC6 body is 1790 bytes with 1776 matching positions. Display and registry dependencies are scripted; real driver behavior remains untested.

Complete Character playback and pose helpers pass 835584 native state/pose comparisons; LoadVue passes 33280 parse/ownership/unwind scenarios. Playback uses the canonical vector-call providers and preserves retail x87 frame-rate precision. Candidate playback is 3333 bytes versus 3327 retail; three existing helper matches remain strict.

Complete WorldToLocalDirection body reviewed against retail and checked with the matrix setters in 86016 native full-state/alias scenarios. Both bodies are 209 bytes but one x87 operand-load order differs; finite tested values match, universal NaN equivalence is not claimed.

Complete SetMatrixIn and SetAxesIn reviewed against retail and checked with the direction transform in 86016 native full-state/alias scenarios. VC6 emits 1134/1171 bytes against 1096/1171 retail; the 41-byte transpose helper remains strict exact. Cache dependencies are scripted in the differential test.

Complete crash filter checked in 13838 native differential scenarios, including both SEH regions and one-shot state. VC6 emits 1277 bytes versus 1290 retail bytes; the stack-base load uses the paired OS backend.

Ordinary-C++ stack-base backend dynamically calls the current OS NtCurrentTeb export. 1536 native main/worker/fiber checks match independent OS bounds; both unavailable-backend paths raise into the reporter's guarded stack-dump failure path.

Complete Tick and profiler calibration checked in 39376 native differential scenarios; QPC replaces the four retail RDTSC boundaries consistently. Gameplay retains ReadClock. VC6 emits 716/204 bytes versus 683/196 retail bytes.
Explicit QPC profiling backend for both Tick stamps and calibration, independently checked in 4096 native bracketed calls. This is a functional platform adaptation, not a retail-byte reconstruction.
Complete DirectX startup probe; VC6 emits 1006 bytes versus 1011 retail bytes due to register allocation and spill differences.
Five complete buffered/archive stream methods reviewed against retail and checked in 12390 native differential scenarios; VC6 bytes remain nonexact.
Complete AddArchive loader checked in 17292 native differential scenarios including constructor unwind paths; VC6 emits 798 bytes versus 804 retail bytes.
